Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.core

Class AuditContext

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.core.AuditContext
public final class AuditContext extends Object
Immutable value object representing the complete execution context and outcome of auditing a single HTML email file.

Lifecycle

An AuditContext is typically constructed in two phases:

  1. Start –
    invalid reference 
    Builder#startedNow()
    records startTime when ingestion begins for a file.
  2. Completion – after rendering, rule execution, and evidence capture, the builder is populated with fileHash, screenshotPath, ruleResults, endTime, and status, then AuditContext.Builder.build() produces the final immutable instance.

Immutability

All fields are final. getRuleResults() returns an unmodifiable list. Instances are safe to share across threads (e.g. handed from a file-processing thread to ReportManager and StateRegistry without defensive copying).

Thread safety

AuditContext itself is immutable and thread-safe. AuditContext.Builder is not thread-safe and must be used by a single thread for the duration of one file's audit.
